items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: But Jesse Hooker, I hung around... I used to follow him around.

ctx.x: Jimmie Noone was all right. I didn't get to meet him. But Jesse Hooker, I hung around... I used to follow him around. I'd go up and listen to his band before we went up there and play behind them, when... They were often working around here and play (?) house in the daylight, and I'd follow him around and listen to him play. So it gave me ideas.
